pages.text: $(l)CONTROLS$()$(br2)$(b)Ctrl+H$() opens your virtual Patchouli Death List. No book item occupies an inventory slot.$(br2)$(6)H$() summons a discovered soul using the shown ingredients, or recalls the owned summon under your crosshair.
$(5)Shift+H$() permanently unbinds the owned summon under your crosshair. Recall restores the captured soul and its bound recipe ingredients, but does not refund the summon charge.
$(c)KILL IT FIRST$()$(br2)Recipes stay $(8)UNDISCOVERED$() until that creature has entered your Death List through a kill. Ingredients by themselves can never unlock a soul.
